title: IRDAI clears Zurich's purchase of additional 19% in Kotak General Insurance
body: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India has approved Zurich Insurance Company Limited's purchase of an additional 19% stake in Kotak Mahindra General Insurance Company, a deal first announced in November 2025. Zurich acquired 70% of the insurer in 2024. Once the purchase completes, Zurich will hold 89% and Kotak Mahindra Bank will retain the remaining 11%.
